race.title: Unibet/British Stallion Studs EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div 2)
race.verdict: ANGEL FOOTSTEPS has been off the track since finishing second at Redcar in the spring but she represents a good yard and in receipt of weight from the rest in an ordinary-looking novice, she could be the answer. Amandari needs to learn how to settle but he's certainly in the right hands, with King's Flight and Tuxedo Black both appealing newcomers. ANGEL FOOTSTEPS AMANDARI (IRE) KING'S FLIGHT
race.bettingForecast: Angel Footsteps (10/11), Amandari (3/1), King's Flight (13/2), Tuxedo Black (7/1), Thriving Miss Lacy (14/1), Platinum Force (25/1), Pull And Prey (33/1), Go For It (33/1), Enalia (66/1), At My Expense (66/1), Don't Tempt Harry (100/1), Brigand (100/1)
